query.description: Search query (file name or path fragment).

path.description: Optional base path to search (relative to workspace).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20).

extensions.description: Optional list of file extensions to include (e.g. ["rs", "md"]).

respect_gitignore.description: Honor .gitignore when true (default: true). Set false to search ignored paths (like grep_files).

symbol_index.description: Also search the symbol index for definitions matching the query (default: false).

symbol_kind.description: Optional symbol kind filter when symbol_index is true.

symbol_limit.description: Maximum symbol hits when symbol_index is true (default: 15).
